en.name: Name
en.noEvents: No component-specific events. Native attributes/events follow the component's root element.
en.attributes: Examples are template fragments: supply the named values and handlers in your page. Import controls from `@lsw-abpvue/theme-shared` and data/page components from `@lsw-abpvue/components`, or use the application template's auto-import preset. Types and models are extracted from the public contract; default expressions are from the current implementation. A dash means no explicit default is declared. Optional boolean props are normally false when omitted.
en.apiIntro: Public exports grouped by import entry. Value exports exist at runtime; type exports are used with `import type`. Source links lead to their declarations.
en.version: This reference follows **main**. The published npm channel is **alpha**; consult [versions and compatibility](/release/compatibility) before relying on a change that has not been published.

zh.name: 名称
zh.noEvents: 没有组件专有事件。原生属性和事件由组件根元素处理。
zh.attributes: 示例为模板片段，需要在页面中提供对应变量和方法。主题控件从 `@lsw-abpvue/theme-shared` 导入，数据与页面组件从 `@lsw-abpvue/components` 导入，也可使用应用模板的自动导入配置。类型和绑定来自公开契约，默认表达式来自当前实现。短横线表示未显式声明默认值；可选 boolean 属性省略时通常为 false。
zh.apiIntro: 按导入入口列出公开导出。值导出存在于运行时；类型导出使用 `import type`。源码链接指向对应声明。
zh.version: 本参考跟随 **main**。npm 已发布通道是 **alpha**；使用尚未发布的变更前请查看[版本与兼容性](/zh/release/compatibility)。

description.en: A themed button with loading, disabled and icon states.
description.zh: 带加载、禁用和图标状态的主题按钮.

notes.en: Loading prevents clicks. Add aria-label when the button has only an icon.
notes.zh: 加载状态会阻止点击。仅显示图标时应提供 aria-label。

description.en: A themed input, textarea or password field.
description.zh: 主题输入框、多行文本和密码输入框。

notes.en: Use type="number" for numeric values. Text inputs emit strings; clearing a numeric input can emit null. Connect labels through AbpFormField.
notes.zh: 数字值使用 type="number"。文本输入输出字符串，清空数字输入可输出 null。使用 AbpFormField 关联标签。

description.en: Single or multiple selection from typed options.
description.zh: 基于选项的单选或多选控件。

notes.en: Each option has value and label; multiple selection uses an array. Labels are display text, so localize them before passing them.
notes.zh: 选项包含 value 和 label；多选值是数组。label 是显示文本，需要传入前完成本地化。

description.en: A checkbox or switch.
description.zh: 复选框或开关。

notes.en: Checkbox and switch variants bind a boolean. Radio controls bind the selected option value. `indeterminate` applies to the checkbox variant. The example uses a boolean switch.
notes.zh: checkbox 和 switch 绑定布尔值，radio 绑定所选选项的值。`indeterminate` 用于 checkbox。示例使用布尔开关。

description.en: A label, validation messages and help text around a control.
description.zh: 为控件提供标签、校验消息和帮助文本。

notes.en: Use the same for and id. Pass already formatted validation messages in errors; do not pass validation rule objects.
notes.zh: for 与控件 id 保持一致。errors 接收已格式化的消息，不直接传入校验规则对象。

description.en: Date, time or datetime input with ISO string values.
description.zh: 以 ISO 字符串绑定日期、时间或日期时间。

notes.en: Values remain strings for ABP DTOs. Basic Theme uses culture-aware date segments and a calendar. Respect min/max and choose date, time or datetime to match your DTO; displaying a date is separate from timezone conversion.
notes.zh: 绑定值保持字符串，便于传入 ABP DTO。Basic Theme 提供符合文化格式的分段输入和日历。按 DTO 选择 date、time 或 datetime，并设置 min/max；显示格式与时区转换是不同操作。

description.en: An asynchronous lookup with separate value and display text.
description.zh: 异步查找控件，分别保存值和显示文本。

notes.en: search returns value/label items and receives an AbortSignal. Respect it in your request. displayValue fills an existing record without another lookup. Basic Theme currently uses its existing typeahead implementation; the reka-ui migration is planned.
notes.zh: search 返回 value/label 选项，并接收 AbortSignal；请求应使用该信号。displayValue 可显示已有记录而无需额外查询。Basic Theme 当前沿用已有自动完成实现，reka-ui 迁移尚未完成。

description.en: A modal dialog with guarded close paths.
description.zh: 带关闭保护的模态框。

notes.en: Cancel, the close button, Esc and the backdrop request a guarded close. Native input changes or dirty trigger a discard confirmation. busy prevents user closes. After a successful save set visible=false directly. Use footer.close() for cancellation. init/appear/disappear describe visibility lifecycle, not completed animations. Focus returns to the trigger.
notes.zh: 取消、关闭按钮、Esc 和遮罩会请求受保护的关闭。原生输入变更或 dirty 会触发丢弃确认，busy 会阻止用户关闭。保存成功后直接设置 visible=false；取消使用 footer.close()。init/appear/disappear 描述可见状态生命周期，不表示动画结束。关闭后焦点返回触发元素。

description.en: Zero-based pagination and a page-size selector.
description.zh: 从零开始的分页与每页条数选择器。

notes.en: Bind ListService.page directly: it is zero-based. total is the total record count, not the number of pages. Render the record-range summary in your page; AbpExtensibleTable includes that summary.
notes.zh: ListService.page 从零开始，可直接绑定。total 是记录总数，不是页数。普通页面自行显示记录范围；AbpExtensibleTable 已包含该摘要。

description.en: An accessible loading indicator.
description.zh: 具有可访问名称的加载指示器。

notes.en: Use a useful label. A spinner does not disable other controls; bind their busy or disabled state separately.
notes.zh: 提供有意义的 label。加载指示器不会禁用其他控件，需要分别绑定 busy 或 disabled。

description.en: Renders notifications from ToasterService.
description.zh: 显示 ToasterService 的通知。

notes.en: Basic Theme installs its notification host in the application shell. Add a host when building your own shell; send messages through useToaster rather than manipulating the host.
notes.zh: Basic Theme 已在应用外壳中安装通知宿主。自定义外壳时添加宿主，通过 useToaster 发送消息。

description.en: Renders pending ConfirmationService requests.
description.zh: 显示 ConfirmationService 的确认请求。

notes.en: Basic Theme provides a host. useConfirmation().warn() resolves to ConfirmationStatus; compare the result with ConfirmationStatus.confirm before a destructive operation.
notes.zh: Basic Theme 已提供宿主。useConfirmation().warn() 返回 ConfirmationStatus，执行删除等操作前应与 ConfirmationStatus.confirm 比较。

description.en: A page heading, toolbar and content container.
description.zh: 页面标题、工具栏与正文容器。

notes.en: title is a localization key. The layout owns the breadcrumb. Use the title slot for a custom heading.
notes.zh: title 接收本地化 key。面包屑由布局提供；自定义标题使用 title 插槽。

description.en: Renders contributed toolbar actions in reusable module pages.
description.zh: 显示可复用模块页面贡献的工具栏操作。

notes.en: Requires an extension identifier and assembled toolbar contributors. Application pages can place ordinary buttons in AbpPage's toolbar slot instead.
notes.zh: 需要扩展标识和已装配的工具栏贡献者。应用业务页面可直接在 AbpPage 的 toolbar 插槽放置普通按钮。

description.en: A table driven by explicit columns and records.
description.zh: 由显式列定义与记录驱动的表格。

notes.en: Sorting updates the `sortKey` and `sortOrder` named models; update your list query to load the sorted data. Selection and expanded rows use named v-model bindings. Table cells render text by default.
notes.zh: 排序更新 `sortKey` 和 `sortOrder` 命名模型，需要更新列表查询以加载排序数据。选择和展开行使用命名 v-model 绑定。默认单元格按文本渲染。

description.en: Row actions displayed as one button or a dropdown.
description.zh: 将行操作显示为单个按钮或下拉菜单。

notes.en: One action becomes a button; multiple actions become a dropdown; no actions render nothing. Plain RowAction.action receives the record. Filter actions by policy before passing them. Omit actions only inside an extensible module context.
notes.zh: 一个操作显示按钮，多个操作显示下拉菜单，没有操作时不显示。普通 RowAction.action 接收记录。传入前按权限过滤操作；仅在模块扩展上下文中省略 actions。

description.en: Accessible tabs with horizontal or vertical orientation.
description.zh: 支持水平或垂直排列的可访问标签页。

notes.en: Items use name, optional text and iconClass. text/name are localized. The caller renders the selected panel. Arrow keys and Home/End move selection.
notes.zh: 标签项包含 name，以及可选 text 和 iconClass。text/name 会本地化。调用者负责显示选中的面板，方向键和 Home/End 可切换选择。

description.en: A module table assembled from column and action contributors.
description.zh: 通过列和操作贡献者装配的模块表格。

notes.en: Requires the module's EXTENSIONS_IDENTIFIER and resolved contributors. Handles paging, sorting, record range and optional search. Column visibility shares the list's preference key. Use AbpDataTable for an application page with explicit columns.
notes.zh: 需要模块的 EXTENSIONS_IDENTIFIER 和已解析的贡献者。处理分页、排序、记录范围与可选搜索。列显隐与列表共用偏好 key。显式定义列的应用页面使用 AbpDataTable。

description.en: Fields assembled from form contributors.
description.zh: 通过表单贡献者装配字段。

notes.en: form is the result of useExtensibleForm. field-{name} replaces one control. Grouped properties render together, and unmatched server errors remain visible.
notes.zh: form 来自 useExtensibleForm。field-{name} 替换一个控件。同组属性一起显示，无法匹配字段的服务端错误仍会展示。

description.en: A dialog view of an extensible module record editor.
description.zh: 模块记录编辑器的对话框视图。

notes.en: editor comes from useRecordEditor in a reusable module. The default body renders the extensible form; header/body/footer can be replaced. Application CRUD pages use AbpModal with their own form and save method.
notes.zh: editor 来自可复用模块中的 useRecordEditor。默认正文显示扩展表单，可替换标题、正文和底部。应用 CRUD 页面使用 AbpModal、自己的表单和保存方法。
